property_summary: For every target recipient address that reverts on receiving Ether, the correct contract's withdraw(...) call (using transfer) will revert (so address(c).balance does not decrease), whereas the mutant using low-level call will not revert and may keep the funds; thus the property: when withdrawing to a reverting recipient, the call to withdraw must revert (ok == false), which holds for the reference and is violated by the mutant for some inputs.
change_summary: Replace transfer with low-level call that returns (does not revert on failure) and ignores returned data, changing whether failed sends revert (affects resulting balances).
